hook: A $275,000 lawsuit over Nicki Minaj's tour hit a sudden wall.

sections.voiceover: A $275,000 lawsuit over Nicki Minaj's tour hit a sudden wall.

On October 27, 2026, Justice Leslie A. Stroth froze proceedings against Pink Friday Productions LLC. Company 24/7 Productions sued over her 2023 Jingle Ball tour. Why did the judge pause this $275,000 fight?
Except the freeze came because her own lawyers requested to walk away.
In court papers, Bruce W. He stated in filed papers that the attorney-client relationship with Nicki Minaj irretrievably broke down. A December hearing will resolve the attorney withdrawal.
The $275,000 dispute remains paused until that exit hearing.
